workload: One entropy() call on tests/test_efficiency_img_dir/frame_4wrwr48cdk6rbcjl.jpg (RGB, 864x1152, values in [0, 1]).
notes: entropy one_hot-encodes every luma pixel into 256 int64 bins and sums them. On this photo that temporary is 864*1152*256*8 bytes and accounts for the measured high-water growth (about 2.04 GiB). bincount or histc produces the same integer histogram, so the entropy value stays the same while the buffer drops to 256 bins.

workload: One 16x16 stride-4 moment map on a float64 Gabor magnitude band (1, 3, 864, 1152) from frame_4wrwr48cdk6rbcjl.jpg scaled by 255, as MAD lo_index consumes.
notes: ical_stat materializes every overlapping patch and reduces it. lo_index does that 40 times per RGB pair (4 orientations x 5 scales x 2 images). Four avg_pool power sums plus the same (B, P, C) view the function already returns matched this band to 3.6e-14 / 9e-13 / 1.4e-11 on std, skew, and kurtosis and ran in about 23 ms versus about 206 ms.

workload: One 4-orientation by 5-scale log-Gabor bank on frame_4wrwr48cdk6rbcjl.jpg scaled to 0-255 (1, 3, 864, 1152), the tensor MAD passes into lo_index.
notes: gaborconvolve rebuilds the filter bank in numpy float64, runs twenty sequential ifft2 calls, and stacks real/imag copies. A vectorized torch filter bank, one batched ifft2, and view_as_real matched every response within 2e-14 and cut a call on this photo from about 0.86 s to about 0.55 s. lo_index runs the bank on both images.
